title: A group
description: A group of rules (groups/G<number>.yaml). The identifier is the file name without its ending. The fields every item shares come from item.json; a group has no scope fields. A group names rules in rules, other groups in groups, or both; what it means is the resolved set of rules, its own and those of every group it includes, each once. A group holds rules only: the principles and definitions that belong to it follow from its rules. That an included group exists and that no group includes itself, directly or through others, only the check can tell.

rules.description: The identifiers of the rules of the group.

groups.description: The identifiers of the groups whose rules this group includes: a short way to name their rules.

purpose.description: What the set of rules is for, as Markdown text without headings.
